baseUrl.description: Plane instance base URL, without the /api/v1 prefix — the connector adds it. A trailing /api or /api/v1 is stripped on save.

apiKey.description: Plane API token from Settings → API Tokens, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

workspace.description: Workspace slug, as it appears in the Plane URL.

userId.description: Cached id of the token's own user, resolved during sync so "my issues" works between syncs. Not user-editable.
